r0.why: Largest system, 2,900 reefs, 900 islands, 2,300 km, 344,400 km2 [1]; Coral Sea off Queensland [2]; channel 160 km wide, 61 m deep [3].

r1.why: Built by billions of polyps [5]; biggest single structure by living things, seen from space [4]; diversity and World Heritage 1981 [6].

r2.why: Too cool until ~25 Mya [41]; sediment from eroding Great Dividing Range after reaching tropics [44]; substrate build-up away from sediment [45]; 150 m and sea-level limits due to sunlight [43].

r3.why: Aboriginal and Torres Strait use and spirituality [13]; Cook 1770 [29]; Endeavour aground, seven weeks repair [30]; Flinders named it 1802 [31]; tourism Whitsundays, Cairns, AUD$3 billion [14,15].

r4.why: Marine park limiting fishing and tourism [10]; runoff, bleaching, dredging sludge, crown-of-thorns [11]; 2012 study, over half cover lost since 1985 [12].

r5.why: 2016 die-off of 800 km northern stretch blamed on climate change [19]; breeding adults died, low births, changed reproducing types [21,22]; March 2022 bleaching [25]; 2022 greatest recovery in 36 years via Acropora on two-thirds [26,27].
